from omegaconf import OmegaConf
from pocket_coffea.config import get_default_config

# Step 1: Fetch framework defaults
default_params = get_default_config()

# Step 2: Load parameter files and overlay onto defaults
object_preselection_params = OmegaConf.load("params/object_preselection.yaml")
triggers_params = OmegaConf.load("params/triggers.yaml")

# Merge with file values overriding defaults (later configs take precedence)
final_params = OmegaConf.merge(default_params, object_preselection_params, triggers_params)
